source_mesh.description: original pre-local2x 200W EI17 multi-material Gmsh v2.2

grading.radial: axis-centered cosine taper gradually restores original mesh toward outer wafer
grading.depth: cosine taper extends node-density adjustment into plasma AND wafer material layers
grading.approach: conforming wafer-interface vertex removal, deterministic graded multilevel interior coarsening, same-material edge flips
grading.unchanged: all physics/boundaries except discretization; all named physical IDs, material areas and boundary lengths
grading.note: graded radial faces are discrete multiples of the original 4.3548mm spacing; transition is through nonuniform intervals and interior multilevel thinning

geometry_validation: original named physical 1D/2D IDs and tags retained
per-material areas and boundary lengths preserved
all non-axis physical boundary edges conforming to triangles
axis, outer geometry and wafer extent unchanged
wafer outermost width restored to original
limitations: Whole-domain min angle 4.804deg existed in the unmodified reference mesh
Too few degrees of freedom removed to claim major wall-clock speedup
This is numerical mesh stabilization test; not a physical or mathematical substitute for resolved fine-mesh solution
Runtime convergence and native D1 ledgers passed for three cases, but no claim that electron density defects are physically solved or grid-converged
provenance: Source generator tracked in repository; canonical graded L1 runtime Gmsh .msh is archived as the immutable 100us Action artifact and locally downloadable, reproducible with issue397_materialize_l1_baseline.py. Historical evidence artifacts untouched.
